evidence.quote: State Highway 325, officially, SH-325, is a 38.08-mile (61.28 km) state highway Cimarron County, Oklahoma, United States, that connects New Mexico State Road 456 (at the New Mexico border west of Kenton) to the traffic circle in Boise City

evidence.claim: The Kenton road became part of the state highway system in 1926, carrying both SH-11 and the new U.S. 64 designation.
evidence.quote: The road was first numbered as a state route in 1926, when the original SH-11 was extended west from its original terminus in Boise City.

evidence.claim: In 1947, U.S. 64 moved to a new road southwest from Boise City, leaving the old route without a highway number.
evidence.quote: On July 7, 1947, US-64 was shifted onto a new road that had opened, extending southwest from Boise City and crossing into New Mexico near the southwest corner of the Panhandle. This left the route to Kenton without a designation

evidence.claim: A brief return as SH-134 followed; the present SH-325 number arrived in 1973.
evidence.quote: Kenton was briefly reconnected to the state highway system when State Highway 134 was designated along the old alignment of US-64.

evidence.claim: A red-brick courthouse stands inside Boise City’s highway traffic circle.
evidence.quote: The courthouse was designed by M.C. Parker in the Classical Revival and Neoclassical styles and built in red brick by Strong & Froman.

evidence.claim: The building opened in 1926, replacing a wooden courthouse destroyed by fire.
evidence.quote: The building opened in 1926 after the previous wood-frame courthouse burned down.

evidence.claim: The town itself began with a fraudulent sales campaign in 1908: developers promised paved streets, businesses and rail service, then sold 3,000 lots they did not own.
evidence.quote: They sold 3,000 lots to buyers who discovered, on their arrival, that none of the information in the brochure was true. In addition to using false publicity, the three men did not have title to the lots they sold.

evidence.claim: Two developers served prison terms for mail fraud.
evidence.quote: Stanley and Kline were convicted of mail fraud and sent to Leavenworth Federal Penitentiary. Stanley and Kline served two-year terms in the penitentiary.

evidence.claim: Despite that beginning, Boise City took shape and incorporated in 1925.
evidence.quote: Despite the fraud by the original developers, the town nevertheless took shape and was incorporated on July 20, 1925.
